description:
Report who was paged during their on-call shifts this week. The program takes no arguments.

`/work/teams.txt` lists team names, one per line. Trim spaces and tabs around each line, skip blank lines and lines starting with `#`, and report a team listed more than once only at its first position.

For each team, read its shifts with `oncall_shifts` (`svc.oncallShifts` in TypeScript) and its pages with `oncall_pages` (`svc.oncallPages`). Times are minutes since the start of the week. A shift covers the minutes from its `start` up to but not including its `end`, and a team's shifts never overlap. The pager can report the same page more than once: count each page `id` of a team once.

A read that fails with a transient kind (`Timeout`, `Unavailable`, `RateLimited`) is tried again 200 milliseconds after it failed, up to 4 attempts in total. If either read of a team fails with `NotFound`, the team is unknown. If a read fails with any other kind, or fails 4 times, the team failed. Report unknown and failed teams by name only.

For every other team, give each person who has at least one shift a count of the pages whose `at` falls in one of their shifts, and a count of those pages whose `severity` is `critical`. A page that falls in no shift is unassigned.

Print one line to standard output: a JSON object with three fields. `teams` holds one `{"team": NAME, "people": [{"person": NAME, "pages": N, "critical": N}, ...], "unassigned": N}` object per reported team, in file order, with `people` sorted by `pages` from most to fewest and then by `person` in byte order. `unknown` and `failed` are lists of team names in file order. Exit with status 0 when no team failed, and 4 otherwise.

Shift.doc: One on-call shift, in minutes since the start of the week; `end` is exclusive.

PageEvent.doc: One page sent to a team, at a minute since the start of the week.

capabilities.description: Lists a team's on-call shifts for the week.
Lists the pages a team received during the week.
